### Contributing guidelines

- [x] I have read [CONTRIBUTING.md](https://github.com/nvim-mini/mini.nvim/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md)
- [x] I have read [CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md](https://github.com/nvim-mini/mini.nvim/blob/main/CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md)

### Module(s)

mini.pick

### Description

Hi @echasnovski,

I've been using `mini.pick` as my primary picker and I would like to propose three small enhancements to its UI customization. These options provide more flexibility for users to tailor the prompt's appearance to specific aesthetics.

### Proposed Features

**1. `prompt_suffix`**
A string to be displayed after the query text, complementing the existing `prompt_prefix`. This allows users to add padding to both sides of the prompt area, making it more visually consistent with the information displayed at the bottom of the picker window.
- **Implementation branch:** `feature/prompt_suffix`

---

**2. `prompt_max_width` & `prompt_fixed_width`**
- **`prompt_max_width`**: A number to limit the maximum width of the prompt area, allowing for a more compact UI regardless of the floating window's size.
- **`prompt_fixed_width`**: (Open to name suggestions) This fixes the prompt width to `prompt_max_width` by padding it with white spaces. This can make the prompt location behave more like a standard input field for a refined UI.
- **Implementation branch:** `feature/prompt_width`

---

**3. `prompt_highlight_caret_position`**
An option to overlay the caret on the character under the cursor (block style) using a new highlight group `MiniPickPromptCaretPosition`. This makes the prompt visuals more consistent with standard terminal and Neovim cursor behavior.
- **Implementation branch:** `feature/prompt_caret_highlight`

---

### Showcase

https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/aae205ae-146b-4fbc-bd49-b8533bfd8a72

---

### Technical Details

The changes are mainly located in `pick.lua`. However, I have also updated `hues.lua` and `base16.lua` to include the new highlight groups required for these features.

#### Preview and Branches

For easier review before opening any PRs, you can check the specific implementations in my fork:

- **Combined version (all features + resolved conflicts):** [dev branch](https://github.com/yurihbm/mini.nvim/tree/dev)
- **Prompt Suffix:** [feature/prompt_suffix](https://github.com/yurihbm/mini.nvim/tree/feature/prompt_suffix)
- **Prompt Width:** [feature/prompt_width](https://github.com/yurihbm/mini.nvim/tree/feature/prompt_width)
- **Caret Highlight:** [feature/prompt_caret_highlight](https://github.com/yurihbm/mini.nvim/tree/feature/prompt_caret_highlight)

---

Would you be open to receiving Pull Requests for these features? If so, please let me know if you prefer them as separate PRs based on the individual branches or as a single PR from the `dev` branch.

Best regards.

comment_data.body:
Thanks for the suggestion!

Although every change is relatively small and already has implementation, after sleeping on it I don't any of this is a good fit for 'mini.pick':

- The `prompt_max_width` and `prompt_fixed_width` don't look like adding much to usability and/or UI. Using as much space as possible for showing prompt seems like a better idea.
- The `prompt_highlight_caret_position` is interesting, but I personally find it really confusing to have block cursor as in Normal mode when it is meant to be used as Insert mode. I'd also prefer if Command-line mode always had vertical bar cursor by default when appending characters.
- I see `prompt_suffix` only be useful if there is a block cursor used together with `prompt_highlight_caret_position`. Otherwise there is already almost full cell width of space to the right of vertical bar caret.
- The usual "'mini.pick' is already very big and has complex config" still applies. It is at the stage of accepting only "big quality-of-life improvement with relatively concise implementation" changes. Neither of these pass this cutoff, I am afraid.

Now, I wish there would be a single `config.window.prompt_format` instead of two `prompt_prefix` and `prompt_caret`. This would have covered all of the suggested here cases *and* simplify config. Unfortunately, it would be a breaking change while making it more complicated to adjust most common things (like prefix and caret). So probably also won't happen, but it might change in the future.

So all in all, I think I am going to close all of this as not planned. Big thank you for providing the code and demos of how it would look though!
